en.summary: In Paraíba state, over 3.2 million eligible voters will participate in the first round of the 2026 elections held on Sunday from 8am to 5pm across 10,845 polling stations.

en.title: 2026 Elections: see guide with everything you need to know to vote in Rio Preto and Araçatuba
en.summary: Voters in São José do Rio Preto and Araçatuba will cast ballots on Sunday from 8am to 5pm for federal and state deputies, two senators, governor, and president in the first round of elections.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: mais de 800 mil eleitores vão às urnas neste domingo em Sorocaba e Jundiaí

en.title: 2026 Elections: over 800,000 voters head to the polls this Sunday in Sorocaba and Jundiaí
en.summary: More than 800,000 voters in Sorocaba and Jundiaí will vote on Sunday from 8am to 5pm to choose president, governor, senator, and federal and state deputies, with thousands of new registered voters.

en.title: Brazilians head to the polls this Sunday for the first round of elections
en.summary: Brazilians participate in the first round of the 2026 elections on Sunday.

en.title: Elections 2026: see the voting order on the electronic ballot
en.summary: Brazilian voters in the 2026 elections will cast ballots for six positions in a specific order on electronic voting machines, beginning with federal deputies and ending with the presidential race.

en.title: Elections 2026: Over 6 million expected to vote this Sunday (4th) in Pará; TRE used boats, planes and helicopters to distribute ballot boxes
en.summary: More than 6.2 million voters in Pará state are expected to participate in the 2026 elections on Sunday, with electoral authorities using multiple transportation methods to deliver voting equipment across the region.

en.title: Elections 2026 feature Supreme Court politicization, centrão strength, low blows and open wounds; see analyses
en.summary: The 2026 Brazilian elections are marked by political tensions involving the Supreme Court, influence from centrist parties, and unresolved conflicts from previous disputes.

en.title: Election Sunday has alerts for storms in SP and other states; see weather forecast
en.summary: An incoming cold front is expected to bring severe weather to Brazil's south, southeast, center-west regions and parts of Pará during Sunday's election voting.

en.title: Paraná has red alert for storms in 143 cities this Sunday of elections; see where
en.summary: Brazil's Paraná state has 143 municipalities under severe weather alert on election day, with forecasts of heavy rainfall exceeding 60 millimeters per hour, winds above 100 km/h, and hail expected throughout the day.

en.title: Nearly 350 thousand voters go to the polls this Sunday in the region's municipalities
en.summary: Approximately 349,411 eligible voters are expected to cast votes in Sunday's elections across eight electoral districts in the Ivaí Valley region plus Arapongas.

en.title: Paraná will not have Dry Law in this first round of 2026 Elections
en.summary: Paraná state will not enforce the Dry Law during the first round of the 2026 elections on Sunday, according to confirmation from the state security authority.

en.title: Time for 2026 Elections: see what time voting begins and ends today

stories.title: Brasil vai hoje às urnas na eleição mais acirrada da história

en.title: Brazil goes to the polls today in the most closely contested election in history
en.summary: Over 158 million eligible voters are participating in Brazil's first round of presidential elections, with polls showing a tight technical tie between the main candidates. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm across the country.

en.title: The Brazilian voter deserves better
en.summary: An opinion piece argues that Brazilian workers who labor long hours and spend considerable time commuting deserve greater respect from political parties and candidates during elections.

stories.title: Saiba onde vai votar cada candidato a presidente neste domingo

en.title: In his final race, Lula approaches the first round with narrow margin against Flávio and fears strategic voting surge
en.summary: President Lula reaches the first round with a tight lead over senator Flávio Bolsonaro, concerned about increased abstention and strategic voting favoring his opponent in the final campaign stretch.

stories.title: Resultado das urnas será decisivo no avanço da disputa à presidência do Senado

en.title: Ballot results will be decisive in advancing the dispute for Senate presidency
en.summary: The first round of elections on Sunday will influence decisions by Senate leaders regarding their potential candidacies for the Senate presidency in February 2027. Prospective candidates will monitor both the Senate election results and the presidential vote outcome.
